name: BufferedIOBase.readinto
reason: The dispatch `.readinto n => readinto n false` (BufOps.lean:144-145, BytesIO's readinto) is its one call with read1=False; the readinto-twins counterexample depends on that flag (with read1=True the loop stops after the buffered bytes and no ValueError arises), reproduced on 3.15.2 (duplicate of the open gh-155074, which the bug record does not list).

name: BufferedIOBase._readinto
reason: The BytesIO model (BytesIO.lean:315-319) covers only the read branch: BytesIO has no readinto1 operation, so the `if read1: data = self.read1(len(b))` branch (:733-734) is never mirrored, and the memoryview cast is only exercised on bytearray.

name: _BufferedIOMixin.tell
reason: mixTell mirrors :786-789, but the failed-seek refutation only needs _pyio's final tell to differ from C's 2; a mixin tell that skipped the pos < 0 check, or answered anything else, still refutes it.

name: _BufferedIOMixin.closed
reason: BP2.closed is self.raw.closed forced to Bool (the property returns the raw's object unchanged); in the failed-seek case it is only the closed test inside an empty flush, so a closed that always answered False still refutes.

name: BufferedReader.__init__
reason: BP2.init answers raw.readable() from a flag with no callback, so a readable() that raises, re-enters or returns a truthy non-bool (accepted here, refused by io: measured) is not modelled; all three refutations hold for any constructor that succeeds.

name: BufferedReader._reset_read_buf
reason: Two assignments; in the failed-seek case it runs only in __init__ (the defect is that seek never reaches it), so the refutation holds for any reset.

name: BufferedReader.read
reason: BP2.read follows :1077-1080 (BufferedRandom's flush first, the size < -1 check, `with self._read_lock` around _read_unlocked); PyBufferedNoHang is refuted because that lock is a non-reentrant allocate_lock, reproduced on 3.15.2 and main while io raises RuntimeError.

name: BufferedReader._read_unlocked
reason: readUnlocked/readMore mirror :1083-1132 (readall branch, fast path, wanted = max(buffer_size, n), nodata_val), but no property states what it returns: in the hang case it only calls raw.read under the lock, in the failed-seek and readinto cases it only leaves read-ahead behind, and each refutation holds for other read-ahead amounts.

name: BufferedReader._peek_unlocked
reason: peekUnlocked mirrors :1146-1154, but readinto-twins only needs it to refill at least two bytes; nothing states what peek returns or how much it reads.

name: BufferedReader._readinto
reason: BP2.readinto/readintoLoop follow :1178-1221 (closed check, nbytes == 0, the avail = min(..., len(buf)) bound and the slice assignment that fails, direct raw readinto, peek refill, read1 exits); BufferedReaderReadintoTwins is refuted at b'abcdefghij', size 3, read(1), readinto(3): io 3, _pyio ValueError, reproduced on 3.15.2 and main.

name: BufferedReader.tell
reason: tellR mirrors :1225, but the failed-seek refutation only needs a value other than C's 2; a tell without the max(..., 0) clamp (-4 here) still refutes, so nothing pins its formula.

name: BufferedWriter.__init__
reason: raw.writable() is a flag answered without a callback (truthy non-bool, raising and re-entering inquiries not modelled), and in BufferedRandom's constructor the failed-seek refutation holds for any writer init that succeeds.

name: BufferedWriter.flush
reason: withLock true flushUnlocked mirrors :1297-1298, but the failed-seek case flushes an empty buffer only; any flush that does nothing on an empty buffer still refutes.

name: BufferedWriter._flush_unlocked
reason: flushUnlocked/flushLoop mirror :1301-1315, but only its closed test with an empty write buffer runs in the counterexample; the write loop, None, BlockingIOError-to-RuntimeError and bad-count paths are not stated by any property.

name: BufferedRandom.__init__
reason: raw._checkSeekable() and the readable/writable inquiries are flags without callbacks (seekable() returning 1 is accepted here and refused by io, measured), and the refutation holds for any constructor that succeeds.

name: BufferedRandom.seek
reason: BP2.seek's random branch follows :1431-1445 in order (whence check, flush, undo read-ahead under the lock, raw.seek, reset under the lock, pos < 0); RandomFailedSeekTwins is refuted because the raw.seek at :1440 raises after the undo and before the reset: io tell 2, _pyio 0, and read() returns data twice, reproduced on 3.15.2 and main.

name: BufferedRandom.tell
reason: The kind-2 branch of BP2.tell mirrors :1448-1451, but the refutation only needs a value other than 2 on an empty write buffer; nothing states its result or the write-buffer branch.

name: BufferedRandom.read
reason: flushIfRandom then BufferedReader.read mirrors :1460-1463, but in the failed-seek case the flush is empty and the read only sets up read-ahead; any read that leaves some read-ahead still refutes.
